summary.ci_method: Student t, df=11, t_0.975=2.200985160082949, mean ± t*std/sqrt(n)
summary.comfort_basis: Design assumption only, not a comfort study: 15 Nm is 0.08 m cuff moment arm times 187.5 N strap force. Peaks at or above this value fail the interaction criterion.
summary.interaction_definition: peak absolute spring-damper strap torque on the human knee
summary.latency_definition: command_timestamp_s - intent_timestamp_s of the sample consumed by that command
summary.load_assumption: Theoretical stair-support moment. A synthetic 70 kg body, not a measured person, places knee_weight_share of its weight on this knee. The moment arm is moment_arm_m*sin(flexion), zero when the knee is straight and moment_arm_m at 90 degrees. The load is a flexion moment. It is not an inverse-dynamics result from a gait lab.
